title: Hong Kong Gold Exchange taps tech strength in joint venture to power gold settlement

article.title: Hong Kong Gold Exchange taps tech strength in joint venture to power gold settlement
article.summary: The Hong Kong Gold Exchange (HKGX) and TGX Technology have launched a joint venture to build a “secure, stable and internationally competitive” gold trading and clearing platform, as the city pushes to become a gold trading hub. Hong Kong Gold Exchange Trading System (HKGXTS) would draw on technology partners, including Alibaba Cloud – which backs TGX Technology – and Hundsun Technologies, to deliver the platform, according to a statement issued on Tuesday.
